concepts.name: 01-hand-painted-classic
concepts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a HAND-DRAWN GAME TEXTURE CONCEPT board, not a physically based 3D render. Inputs 1/2/3 are the LOCKED final mesh in TOP (nose up), SIDE (nose right), and FRONT orthographic captures. Keep the exact shape, part boundaries, silhouette and proportions of THESE mesh captures. Input 4 is the strongest STYLE AUTHORITY: small painted spaceship game sprite with thick dark ink contours, warm off-white silver armor, broad brush-painted light shapes, very simple cel-like shadows, red inserts, black glass and charming subtly irregular hand-painted edges. Input 5 is original color placement only, not geometry. Layout: large top at left, side and front stacked at right on quiet warm gray paper. Material/color placement: warm silver/off-white armor plates, saturated red recessed wing channels and fin insets, near-black charcoal structural web and engine housings, near-black canopy with red geometric rims and one broad painted glass highlight, tiny green service accents. Symmetrical coherent paint across the views. Paint should look illustrated and readable at small strategy-game scale: dark charcoal outline strokes and panel seams, broad deliberately painted cream highlights, restrained cool gray/violet shadow blocks, very sparse tiny scratches. Keep broad faces visually quiet. NO photorealism, brushed-metal grain, shiny chrome, realistic specular gradients, PBR render, procedural wear, rivet noise, new greebles, added panels or redesigned geometry. Do not change twin prows, low canopy, twin engines or layered upper/lower wings. Texture/style ONLY. Three orthographic paintovers must look like the supplied same mesh. Variant A: Closest to the supplied small sprite: warm ivory-silver armor, bold black ink edges, rich vermilion red accents, dark painted shadow shapes, clean confident broad brushwork. Label title A / HAND-PAINTED CLASSIC and views TOP, SIDE, FRONT.
